description: Package resolver fallback for ecosystems beyond crates.io/PyPI/npm. When registry API returns an error, fallback_with_warning produces deterministic fallback URLs with a warning.

expect.notes: Package resolver supports all 10 ecosystems: crates.io, PyPI, npm, Go, Maven, NuGet, RubyGems, Packagist, OCI, and GitHub Actions. On registry API failure, fallback_with_warning creates deterministic fallback URLs (e.g. Maven Central search, Docker Hub, GitHub repos API). Fallback is metadata-only — no dependency solving, no artifact download. Tested via unit tests: fallback_with_warning_maven, fallback_with_warning_nuget, fallback_with_warning_rubygems, fallback_with_warning_packagist.
